summary: Owner Dashboard feature tested end-to-end. Backend: 9/9 pytest cases pass covering admin JWT gating (401 unauth on /api/admin/* and legacy admin GET endpoints), demotion of old admin to guest (403), guest 403, request-mode booking creation, admin approve/decline/cancel workflow, availability + 409 overlap guard, declined bookings persisted (not deleted) and dates still free, admin enquiries aggregator with type labels, overview counts. Frontend (/owner): login form renders, wrong password shows owner-login-error, admin login shows owner-dashboard with stats and tabs, pending booking card shows guest contact details (name/email/phone), Approve updates status pill to confirmed in-place and decrements pending badge, All bookings tab Cancel button sets status to cancelled, Enquiries filter chips (consultation, contact) filter the list correctly, owner-logout returns to login, demoted mukeshkhandelwal212@gmail.com sees owner-denied screen, denied-logout returns to login. Known-ignored: email notifications 401 (per task note).

issues: After local approve/cancel, owner-stat-upcoming and owner-stat-bookings/enquiries are not re-synced from server (only pending_requests is adjusted client-side). Minor stale-count display until Refresh is clicked. Consider calling load() or returning new overview from the action endpoint.

action_items: Optional polish: after approve/decline/cancel, re-fetch overview (or have the admin endpoint return it) so upcoming_stays and total counts stay in sync without a manual Refresh.
critical_code_review_comments: Admin gating is consistent via Depends(require_admin) on all /admin/* and legacy list endpoints.
Admin status update correctly re-checks overlap only when transitioning to 'confirmed' (409 guard).
Declined bookings are preserved (status update, no deletion) and do not block availability – matches requirement.
startup_auth idempotently re-hashes ADMIN_PASSWORD and demotes other admins; good.
server.py is 1079 lines – nearing the >700 split threshold; consider splitting routers (auth, stays, admin, catalog) into modules.
